title: The Anatomy of a Blind Spot: What an LLM Judge Must Be Shown, and How Much
abstract: arXiv:2610.15938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluation of text generated by large language models (LLMs) is increasingly delegated to LLMs acting as judges, yet what such a judge must be shown remains unresolved. We treat a judge whose reports are acted on as a regulator, in the sense of cybernetics, and ask what it must be shown, how much, in what form, and what its reports must get right. On seven public benchmarks we varied only what the judge was shown. Across three judges whose prices differ 10- to 17-fold, what the judge was shown mattered more than which judge it was. When a system revised its answers on feedback from a judge denied the material they had to respect, it ended below its starting point on instruction following and question answering. On instruction following the loss grew with each round, and it persisted when the judge saw the user's request but not the constraints and with a second judge family. translated_title: 盲点剖析：LLM评判者必须看到什么，以及需要看到多少
translated_abstract: 对大型语言模型（LLM）所生成文本的评估越来越多地交由充当评判者的LLM来完成，然而这样一个评判者必须被展示什么内容仍悬而未决。我们将一个其报告会被实际采纳执行的评判者视为控制论意义上的调节器，并探究它必须被展示什么、展示多少、以何种形式展示，以及它的报告必须准确把握什么。在七个公开基准测试上，我们仅改变评判者所被展示的内容。在三个价格相差10至17倍的评判者之中，评判者被展示的内容比使用哪个评判者更为重要。当一个系统根据一个未被告知其所必须遵守材料的评判者的反馈来修改答案时，它在指令遵循和问答任务上的表现最终低于初始水平。在指令遵循任务上，这种损失随每一轮迭代而增长，并且当评判者看到用户的请求但看不到约束条件时，以及在使用第二个评判者模型家族时，这种损失依然存在。在新闻摘要任务上，一个正确的参考摘要放在旁边……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将LLM评判者视为控制论意义上的调节器，通过七个基准测试的对照实验发现，评判者被展示的信息内容比选择哪个评判者模型更为重要，而让系统依据看不到关键参考材料的评判者反馈反复修改，会导致性能持续下降并低于初始水平。
en_tdlr: Treating an LLM judge as a cybernetic regulator, this paper demonstrates across seven benchmarks that what the judge is shown matters more than which judge is used, and that systems revising answers based on judges denied the reference material they must respect degrade persistently below their starting point.
